data.one_liner: TextInputFormatter for TextField and TextFormField to format input using a given mask.
data.what_it_does: Provides a TextInputFormatter that automatically formats text input in TextField and TextFormField widgets based on a defined mask string and regular expression filters. It supports both lazy and eager autocompletion modes, allows retrieving unmasked values, and lets you update masks dynamically.
use_when: You need to format phone numbers, credit cards, dates, or other structured input in text fields.
You need to easily retrieve both the masked and unmasked values from a text field.
avoid_when: You require a full form builder solution rather than just an input formatter.
strengths: Easy integration with standard Flutter TextField and TextFormField widgets.
Supports dynamic mask updates and lazy/eager autocompletion types.
Provides methods to retrieve both masked and unmasked text values easily.
weaknesses: Limited to text formatting via string masks and filters.
No built-in comprehensive collection of predefined regional masks (like international phone formats) out of the box.
